sequences.query:
activity_type:"process-create"
AND
(
  (
    process_command_line:RGXi("python")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("socket")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("connect")
  )
  OR
  (
    process_command_line:RGXi("perl")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("socket")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("connect")
  )
  OR
  (
    process_command_line:RGXi("php")
    AND process_command_line:RGXi("fsockopen")
  )
)
AND NOT user="root"
AND process_command_line:RGXi("/tmp/|/var/tmp/|/dev/shm/")
